Lab900FormConfig.name: Lab900FormConfig
Lab900FormConfig.typeParameters: R = any, T extends string | number = string, DATE = Date
Lab900FormConfig.description:
The schema of a form. Pass it to the `schema` input of `<lab900-form>`: the form builds its
`UntypedFormGroup` from `fields` and renders every field, so there is no template to write.

Keep the config in a class field. A new object on every change detection rebuilds the form and
loses the values the user has typed.

members.name: title
members.description: Heading above the fields. A translation key.

members.name: fields
members.description: The fields of the form, in render order. Each one is a member of the `Lab900FormField` union.

members.name: readonly
members.description:
Makes every field of the form readonly. A readonly control is disabled, so it leaves
`form.value` of a plain `FormGroup`; `Lab900Form.value` uses `getRawValue()` and keeps it.

members.name: formId
members.description:
Identifies this form to the conditions of another one. Pass the form under this key in the
`externalForms` input of the other form and reference it with `IFieldConditions.externalFormId`.
Defaults to a generated id.

Lab900FormFieldOptions.name: Lab900FormFieldOptions
Lab900FormFieldOptions.description: The Material form field defaults of every field, plus the library's own additions.

members.name: showLengthIndicator
members.description: Shows a character counter on the fields that have a `maxLength`.

Lab900AmountFieldOptions.name: Lab900AmountFieldOptions
Lab900AmountFieldOptions.description: The defaults of every `EditType.Amount` field. A field can still override them in its options.

members.name: minDecimals
members.description: The fewest decimals an amount is padded to.

members.name: maxDecimals
members.description: The most decimals an amount is formatted to.

members.name: locale
members.description: The locale the amount is formatted for. Defaults to the locale of the application.

Lab900FormModuleSettings.name: Lab900FormModuleSettings
Lab900FormModuleSettings.description:
The application-wide defaults of the library. Pass them to `provideLab900Forms()`.

`provideLab900Forms()` is required: besides these settings it registers `LAB900_FORM_FIELD_TYPES`,
the map from `EditType` to component. Without it every field renders as `UnknownFieldComponent`.

members.name: formField
members.description: Material form field defaults: `appearance`, `floatLabel`, `hideRequiredMarker`, ...

members.name: fieldMask
members.description: `ngx-mask` defaults, used by the input masks and the amount field.

members.name: amountField
members.description: Defaults of the amount field.

members.name: disableBrowserAutocomplete
members.description: Sets `autocomplete="off"` on the inputs, so the browser does not offer its own suggestions.

members.name: devWarnings
members.description:
Warns in the console about the schema mistakes the library otherwise fails silently on: an
unknown `editType`, a select whose object value never matches its options because `compareWith`
is missing, a `readonlyDisplay` that returns something other than a primitive, and a schema that
is rebuilt on every change detection run.

Development only, and each message is logged once. Set it to `false` when the warnings are noise.

Lab900FormField.name: Lab900FormField
Lab900FormField.typeParameters: R = any, T extends string | number = string, DATE = Date
Lab900FormField.description:
Every kind of field a schema may hold. `editType` discriminates the union, so setting it narrows
`options` to the options interface of that field and TypeScript checks the rest for you.
Lab900FormField.example: const field: Lab900FormField = { attribute: 'email', editType: EditType.Input, options: { required: true } };
Lab900FormField.type: | FormFieldInput<T> | FormFieldPassword<T> | FormFieldMultiLang<T> | WysiwgFieldModel<T> | FormFieldSearch<R, T> | FormFieldSelect<R, T> | CheckboxFieldModel<T> | FormFieldRadioButtons<T> | FormFieldFilePreview<T> | FormFieldDragNDropFilePreview<T> | FormFieldIcon<T> | FormRow<T> | FormColumn<T> | FormFieldButtonToggle<T> | FormFieldButton<T> | FormFieldSlideToggle<T> | FormFieldRangeSlider<T> | FormFieldDatePicker<T, DATE> | FormFieldDateYearMonthPicker<T, DATE> | FormFieldDateTimePicker<T, DATE> | FormFieldDateRange<T, DATE> | FormFieldAutocomplete<R, T> | FormFieldAutocompleteMulti<R, T> | FormFieldRepeater<T> | FormFieldTextarea<T> | FormFieldAmount<T>

ValueLabel.name: ValueLabel
ValueLabel.description:
One option of a select, autocomplete, radio group or button toggle. The control stores `value`;
`label` is what the user reads, and it goes through the translate pipe.

members.name: value
members.description: What the control holds once this option is picked. Set `compareWith` when it is an object.

members.name: label
members.description: A translation key, or plain text when no key matches.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Shows the option but blocks it from being picked.

Icon.name: Icon
Icon.description:
An icon. Use `name` for a Material Icons ligature, or `svgName` for an svg you registered in
`MatIconRegistry` yourself.

members.name: name
members.description: A Material Icons ligature, for example `'search'`. Needs the Material Icons font.

members.name: svgName
members.description: The name of an svg registered in `MatIconRegistry`. Takes precedence over `name`.

ReactiveOption.name: ReactiveOption
ReactiveOption.description:
An option that may change while the form is in use. It accepts three forms:

- a plain value: `readonly: true`
- a function of the raw value of the form group: `hide: data => data.type !== 'company'`
- a signal: `required: this.vatRequired`

The function may also return a signal. Prefer a signal for state that changes over time: the field
reads it inside a `computed`, so the view follows without a new schema object.

Inside a field component, resolve these with the `computeReactive*Option()` helpers, never by
reading the raw option.

ReactiveBooleanOption.name: ReactiveBooleanOption
ReactiveBooleanOption.description: A {@link ReactiveOption} that resolves to a boolean.

ReactiveStringOption.name: ReactiveStringOption
ReactiveStringOption.description: A {@link ReactiveOption} that resolves to a string.

ReactiveNumberOption.name: ReactiveNumberOption
ReactiveNumberOption.description: A {@link ReactiveOption} that resolves to a number.

ReadonlyDisplayValue.name: ReadonlyDisplayValue
ReadonlyDisplayValue.description:
What a readonly field is able to render. A readonly value ends up in the translate pipe, and that pipe
only guards on `!query || !query.length`: an array reaches `TranslateService.instant()`, which calls
`key.split('.')` on every item and throws on the first item that is not a string. So `readonlyDisplay`
has to reduce the field to a single primitive; use {@link toReadonlyDisplayString } to render anything else.

ReadonlyDisplayFn.name: ReadonlyDisplayFn
ReadonlyDisplayFn.description:
Renders a readonly field. The result is treated as a translation key first, and rendered as is when no translation matches. The result reaches the template through `[innerHTML]`, so basic formatting tags such as `
` work. Angular sanitizes the result and strips scripts and event handlers. **`data` is not the same value for every edit type.** Most fields pass the raw value of the whole form group, so read the attribute you need off it. `EditType.Select` passes the value of the field itself, because it resolves the option labels on its own. Check which one you are writing for; the parameter is `any`, so a mismatch fails at runtime and not at compile time.

FormFieldBase.name: FormFieldBase
FormFieldBase.typeParameters: T extends string | number = string, O extends FormFieldBaseOptions = FormFieldBaseOptions
FormFieldBase.description:
What every field of the `Lab900FormField` union has in common. A concrete field adds its
`editType` and narrows `options` to its own options interface.

members.name: attribute
members.description:
The name of the control in the form group. A dotted value (`address.street`) creates the
intermediate groups on its own. A layout field without an attribute flattens its
`nestedFields` into the parent group.

members.name: title
members.description: The label of the field. A translation key.

members.name: validators
members.description: Validators on top of the ones the builder derives from `options`.

members.name: errorMessages
members.description:
Overrides the message of an error key, for example `{ email: 'label.email-error' }`. A key that
is not here falls back to the built-in `forms.error.*` message.

members.name: conditions
members.description: Rules that watch another control and flip this field's state, options or validators.

members.name: options
members.description: The configuration of the field. Which interface applies follows from `editType`.

members.name: nestedFields
members.description: The children of a `Row`, a `Column` or a `Repeater`.

FormFieldBaseOptions.name: FormFieldBaseOptions
FormFieldBaseOptions.description:
The options every field accepts. Each edit type extends this with its own.

Do not disable a control yourself to lock or hide a field: set `readonly` or `hide` and the
library disables it for you.

members.name: hide
members.description: Hides the field and disables its control, so it no longer validates.

members.name: required
members.description: Adds or removes `Validators.required`.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Renders the value instead of an editable field, and disables the control.

members.name: hint
members.type: { /** A translation key. */ value?: string; /** Hides the hint once the control is valid. */ hideHintOnValidValue?: boolean; /** Interpolation parameters for the translation. */ valueTranslateData?: object }
members.description: Help text under the field.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: The text shown in an empty field. A translation key.

members.name: colspan
members.description: The width of the field on the 12 column grid: 1 to 12.

members.name: mobileCols
members.description: Keeps the colspan on mobile instead of stacking. Only for form rows.

members.name: minLength
members.description: Also adds `Validators.minLength`.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Also adds `Validators.maxLength`.

members.name: min
members.description: Also adds `Validators.min`.

members.name: max
members.description: Also adds `Validators.max`.

members.name: defaultValue
members.description: The value the control starts with when the data holds nothing for this attribute.

members.name: pattern
members.description: Also adds `Validators.pattern`.

members.name: readonlyContainerClass
members.description: Extra class on the container of the readonly field.

members.name: readonlyLabel
members.description: Replaces `title` when the field is readonly. A translation key.

members.name: readonlyDisplay
members.description: Renders the value when the field is readonly.

members.name: onChangeFn
members.description: Runs whenever the value of this control changes.

members.name: infoTooltip
members.type: | { text: string; icon?: string; class?: string } | ((data?: any) => { text: string; icon?: string; class?: string } | null)
members.description: An icon next to the label with a tooltip. Return `null` from the function to hide it.

members.name: elementId
members.description: Overrides the element id, which defaults to the attribute name.

EditType.name: EditType
EditType.description:
Picks the component that renders a field. It also discriminates the `Lab900FormField` union, so
setting it narrows `options` to the options interface of that field.

`FormFieldMappingService` maps a member to a component class, read from the
`LAB900_FORM_FIELD_TYPES` token. A value with no mapping renders `UnknownFieldComponent` instead
of throwing.
EditType.type: { Checkbox = 'Checkbox', TextArea = 'TextArea', Date = 'Date', DateYearMonth = 'DateYearMonth', Wysiwyg = 'Wysiwyg', Input = 'Input', Password = 'Password', File = 'File', FilePreview = 'FilePreview', DragNDrop = 'DragNDrop', Search = 'Search', Select = 'Select', Repeater = 'Repeater', RadioButtons = 'RadioButtons', RangeSlider = 'RangeSlider', Row = 'Row', Column = 'Column', Autocomplete = 'Autocomplete', AutocompleteMultiple = 'AutocompleteMultiple', Icon = 'Icon', ButtonToggle = 'ButtonToggle', Button = 'Button', SlideToggle = 'SlideToggle', DateRange = 'DateRange', DateTime = 'DateTime', MultiLangInput = 'MultiLangInput', Amount = 'Amount' }

IFieldConditions.name: IFieldConditions
IFieldConditions.description:
Makes a field react to another control. The condition subscribes to the controls named in
`dependOn` and then flips visibility, disabled state, validators or the options of a select.

Use a condition when a field depends on another **control**; use a reactive option
(`options.hide`, `options.required`, ...) when it only depends on the form value as a whole.

Creating the condition **throws** when `dependOn` names a control that does not exist, unless
`skipIfNotExists` is set.

members.name: dependOn
members.description: The attribute, or attributes, of the control(s) to watch.

members.name: distinctUntilChangedCompareFn
members.description: Decides whether the watched value really changed. Defaults to a reference comparison.

members.name: externalFormId
members.description:
Watch a control in another form instead of this one. The id resolves against the
`externalForms` input of `<lab900-form>`.

members.name: hideIfHasValue
members.description: Hides this field while the watched control holds a value.

members.name: showIfHasValue
members.description: Shows this field only while the watched control holds a value.

members.name: disableIfHasValue
members.description: Disables this field while the watched control holds a value.

members.name: enableIfHasValue
members.description: Enables this field only while the watched control holds a value.

members.name: hideIfEquals
members.description: Hides this field when the watched value equals this, or when the predicate returns true.

members.name: showIfEquals
members.description: Shows this field only when the watched value equals this, or when the predicate returns true.

members.name: disableIfEquals
members.description: Disables this field when the watched value equals this, or when the predicate returns true.

members.name: enabledIfEquals
members.description: Enables this field only when the watched value equals this, or when the predicate returns true.

members.name: onChangeFn
members.type: (value: T, currentControl: AbstractControl, currentScheme: Readonly<Lab900FormField>) => void
members.description: Runs whenever the watched value changes. Use it for a side effect, such as patching this control.

members.name: conditionalOptions
members.type: ( value: T, currentControl: AbstractControl, options?: { page?: number; searchQuery?: string }, schema?: FormFieldSelect<T> ) => ValueLabel[] | Observable<ValueLabel[]>
members.description: Reloads the options of an `EditType.Select` whenever the watched value changes.

members.name: skipIfNotExists
members.description:
Ignore the condition when the watched control is missing, instead of throwing. Use it when the
control is only in the schema some of the time.

members.name: validators
members.description: The validators this field should have for the current watched value. Recalculated on every change.

Lab900File.name: Lab900File
Lab900File.description:
A `File` with what `EditType.FilePreview` needs to render it: a name to show, and the image data
once it is loaded.

A file the user just picked is a real `File` with `fileName` added. A file that already exists on
the server usually is not: build the object yourself with the fields below, and let
`options.httpCallback` fetch the bytes when the preview needs them.

members.name: fileName
members.description: The name shown under the thumbnail. `File.name` is readonly, so the display name lives here.

members.name: imageSrc
members.description: The URL the thumbnail loads from. Without it the field shows the overlay or nothing.

members.name: imageBase64
members.description:
The image as a data URL, which the preview dialog renders. `options.httpCallback` fills it in on
first open, so a file behind an authenticated URL never has to be public.

members.name: customClass
members.description: An extra class on the row element, next to `lab900-form-row`.

members.name: customTitleClass
members.description: An extra class on the row's title, next to `lab900-form-field-label lab900-form-row-label`.

FormRow.name: FormRow
FormRow.description:
A row of the 12 column grid, holding its children in `nestedFields`. It holds no value of its own.

**The `attribute` decides the shape of the data.** With one, the row creates a nested `FormGroup`
and its children live under that key; without one, the children are flattened into the parent
group and the row is layout only. A dotted attribute on a field (`address.street`) creates the
same nesting without a row, so reach for a row when you want the grouping *and* the layout.

It renders its own readonly state, since a single readonly field cannot render children.

members.name: customClass
members.description: An extra class on the column element, next to `lab900-form-column`.

members.name: customTitleClass
members.description: An extra class on the column's title, next to `lab900-form-field-label lab900-form-row-label`.

FormColumn.name: FormColumn
FormColumn.description:
A column that stacks its `nestedFields` vertically, where a `FormRow` lays them out across the 12
column grid. Use `options.colspan` to say how wide the column itself is. It holds no value of its
own.

Like a row, an `attribute` makes it a nested `FormGroup` and no attribute flattens the children
into the parent group. It renders its own readonly state.

AmountOptions.name: AmountOptions
AmountOptions.description:
The decimal settings on their own, for formatting an amount outside a form: `getAmountFormatter()`
and the `amount` pipe take these. A field takes {@link AmountFieldInputOptions} instead.

members.name: maxDecimals
members.description: The most decimals to print.

members.name: minDecimals
members.description: The fewest decimals to print, padding with zeroes.

members.name: autofocus
members.description: Focuses the input once it renders.

members.name: maxDecimals
members.description:
The most decimals the value is formatted to. Overrides
`provideLab900Forms({ amountField: { maxDecimals } })` for this field.

members.name: minDecimals
members.description:
The fewest decimals the value is padded to. Overrides
`provideLab900Forms({ amountField: { minDecimals } })` for this field.

members.name: suffix
members.description: Text after the input, typically a currency. A translation key.

members.name: prefix
members.description: Text before the input, typically a currency. A translation key.

members.name: align
members.description: Which way the number is aligned. Amounts usually read better on the right.

members.name: style
members.description: Inline CSS on the input element itself.

FormFieldAmount.name: FormFieldAmount
FormFieldAmount.description:
A number input that formats as the user types: thousand separators and a fixed number of decimals,
in the locale of `provideLab900Forms({ amountField: { locale } })` or of the application.

The control value stays a `number`, so nothing has to be parsed back.

members.name: icon
members.description: An icon inside the form field, before or after the input.

members.name: displayOptionFn
members.description: Renders the label of an option.
members.deprecated: Labels are set in the autocompleteOptions

members.name: displayInputFn
members.description: Turns the picked value into the text shown in the input. Required.

members.name: disabledOptionFn
members.description: Shows an option but blocks it from being picked.

members.name: autocompleteOptions
members.type: ( searchTerm: string, currentControl: AbstractControl ) => ValueLabel<T>[] | Observable<ValueLabel<T>[]>
members.description: Loads the options for what the user has typed so far. May return an array or an `Observable`.

members.name: debounceTime
members.description: How long typing pauses before the options are loaded again.

members.name: requireMatch
members.description:
Adds a validator that rejects text the user typed but never picked from the list, so the control
cannot hold a value that is not one of the options. It reports `requireMatch`.

FormFieldAutocomplete.name: FormFieldAutocomplete
FormFieldAutocomplete.typeParameters: T, R extends string | number = string
FormFieldAutocomplete.deprecated:
Use `EditType.Select` with `options.search.enabled`. The select does the same thing and
also handles multiple values, paging and "select all".

FormFieldAutocompleteMulti.name: FormFieldAutocompleteMulti
FormFieldAutocompleteMulti.description: The same options as `EditType.Autocomplete`, over an array value.

members.name: type
members.description: Which `@lab900/ui` button to render: filled, stroked, icon-only and so on. Required.

members.name: color
members.description: The Material palette of the button.

members.name: onClick
members.type: (formGroup: UntypedFormGroup, currentScheme: Readonly<Lab900FormField>, event: Event) => any
members.description:
Runs on click, with the group this button sits in, its own schema, and the DOM event. It is not
a submit: the form has no submit of its own, so do the work here.

members.name: label
members.description: The text on the button. A translation key.

members.name: tooltip
members.type: { /** A translation key. */ text: string; position?: TooltipPosition }
members.description: A tooltip, which is also the only description an icon-only button has.

members.name: prefixIcon
members.description: An icon before the label. A Material ligature, or an svg name when `svgIcon` is set.

members.name: suffixIcon
members.description: An icon after the label. A Material ligature, or an svg name when `svgIcon` is set.

members.name: svgIcon
members.description:
Reads `prefixIcon` and `suffixIcon` as svg names registered in `MatIconRegistry` instead of as
Material ligatures.

members.name: containerClass
members.description: An extra class on the element around the button, for spacing it inside the layout.

members.name: buttonId
members.description: The `id` of the button element, for a test hook or an anchor.

FormFieldButton.name: FormFieldButton
FormFieldButton.description:
A button inside the schema, so an action can sit between the fields instead of outside the form.

It holds no value: leave out `attribute`, or the group gains a control that stays empty. It keeps
rendering when the field is readonly, so guard the action with `options.hide` or `options.readonly`
on its own terms.

members.name: buttonOptions
members.type: { /** What the control holds once this button is picked. */ value: any; /** The text on the button. A translation key. Leave it out for an icon-only button. */ label?: string; icon?: Icon & { position?: 'left' | 'right' }; /** An extra class on this one button, to colour or size it apart from the others. */ buttonClass?: string; /** A tooltip, which is also the only description an icon-only button has. */ tooltip?: { /** A translation key. */ text: string; position?: TooltipPosition } }[]
members.description: The buttons to pick from. Required: without them the field renders an empty row.

members.name: color
members.description: The Material palette of the toggle group.

members.name: hideSelection
members.description: Hides the checkmark on the picked button, leaving only its highlight.

members.name: deselectOnClick
members.description:
Clicking the picked button clears the control instead of leaving it as it is, so the field can
go back to having no answer.

FormFieldButtonToggle.name: FormFieldButtonToggle
FormFieldButtonToggle.description:
A row of connected buttons, one of which is picked: a compact alternative to a radio group for a
handful of short options. It keeps rendering its buttons when the field is readonly, rather than
collapsing into text.

members.name: disabledIndeterminate
members.description:
Renders a `null` value as unchecked instead of indeterminate. By default a checkbox has three
visible states, because a control that was never answered holds `null` rather than `false`.

members.name: color
members.description: The Material palette of the checkbox.

CheckboxFieldModel.name: CheckboxFieldModel
CheckboxFieldModel.description:
A single checkbox. The control value is `true`, `false`, or `null` while it has never been
answered - which renders as indeterminate unless `disabledIndeterminate` is set.

`options.required` demands a truthy value, so it makes the checkbox one that has to be ticked.

FormFieldDatePickerOptions.name: FormFieldDatePickerOptions
FormFieldDatePickerOptions.description:
The options every date field shares. `T` is the date type of the application's `DateAdapter`:
`Date` with `provideNativeDateAdapter()`, or a Luxon, Moment or date-fns type with theirs.

members.name: startView
members.description: Which panel the calendar opens on.

members.name: maxDate
members.description: The latest date that can be picked. It also blocks a later date typed into the input.

members.name: minDate
members.description: The earliest date that can be picked. It also blocks an earlier date typed into the input.

members.name: dateFilter
members.description: Function to filter which dates are selectable in the datepicker

members.name: dateClass
members.description: Function that can be used to add custom CSS classes to dates

FormFieldDatePicker.name: FormFieldDatePicker
FormFieldDatePicker.typeParameters: T extends string | number = string, D = Date
FormFieldDatePicker.description:
A date picker. The control value is whatever the application's `DateAdapter` produces, so the form
needs `provideNativeDateAdapter()` or another adapter.

members.name: startLabel
members.description: The placeholder of the start input. A translation key.

members.name: endLabel
members.description: The placeholder of the end input. A translation key.

members.name: startKey
members.description: The name of the control that holds the start date inside the field's group.

members.name: endKey
members.description: The name of the control that holds the end date inside the field's group.

FormFieldDateRange.name: FormFieldDateRange
FormFieldDateRange.typeParameters: T extends string | number = string, D = Date
FormFieldDateRange.description:
A start and an end date in one field. Unlike the other date fields it holds a **group** of two
controls, not one value, so the data for it is an object:

```ts
{ holiday: { start: new Date('2026-07-01'), end: new Date('2026-07-15') } }
```

Rename those two keys with `startKey` and `endKey` when the data already uses other names.

DateAdapterDisplayFormat.name: DateAdapterDisplayFormat
DateAdapterDisplayFormat.description:
Display format that a `DateAdapter` accepts: `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options for the native adapter,
a format string for the Luxon, Moment and date-fns adapters.

members.name: showSeconds
members.description: Adds seconds to the time picker and to the default display format.

members.name: defaultTime
members.description: The time a freshly picked date starts at, as `[hours, minutes, seconds]`. Midnight when unset.

members.name: stepMinute
members.description: How many minutes one step of the minute picker moves.

members.name: displayFormat
members.description:
Format that the input uses to show the selected date and time. Give a value that the
`DateAdapter` of the application accepts.

Optional. By default the field takes the date format of the application and adds the time to it,
in the shape that the application's own `DateAdapter` reads, with seconds when `showSeconds` is
true. Set this option to print a different format, or when the application's own date format
already contains a time.

FormFieldDateTimePicker.name: FormFieldDateTimePicker
FormFieldDateTimePicker.typeParameters: T extends string | number = string, D = Date
FormFieldDateTimePicker.description:
A date with a time, from `@ngx-mce/datetime-picker`. The control value is one date, with the time
set on it.

members.name: startView
members.description:
Which panel the calendar opens on. The month panel is not offered here: picking a month closes
the calendar.

FormFieldDateYearMonthPicker.name: FormFieldDateYearMonthPicker
FormFieldDateYearMonthPicker.typeParameters: T extends string | number = string, D = Date
FormFieldDateYearMonthPicker.description:
A picker that stops at the month: the calendar closes once a month is chosen and never shows days.
The control value is still a full date, on the first day of that month.

members.name: maxFiles
members.description:
How many files the field accepts. It also adds a validator, so more than this many files makes
the control invalid rather than dropping the extras. `1` renders the field as a single file
picker; anything else, or nothing, allows a multiple selection.

members.name: compact
members.description:
Renders the drop zone at a reduced height once a file has been picked, for a form where the field
is not the main subject.

members.name: dropFilesText
members.description: The instruction in the drop zone, which is also its accessible name. A translation key.

members.name: dropFilesButton
members.description: The label of the button that opens the file picker. A translation key.

FormFieldDragNDropFilePreview.name: FormFieldDragNDropFilePreview
FormFieldDragNDropFilePreview.description:
A drop zone that takes files by drag and drop or through a file picker. The control value is a
`File[]`; use `EditType.FilePreview` for files that are already stored and have a preview.

`options.maxFiles` and `options.required` both become validators, so the form is invalid while the
file count is wrong.

members.name: fileUploadButtonText
members.description: The label of the upload button. A translation key.

members.name: canEditFileMetaData
members.description:
Clicking a file opens `fileMetaDataConfig` in a dialog instead of the image preview, and adds a
separate preview icon next to the file name.

members.name: fileMetaDataConfig
members.description: The schema of the metadata dialog. The file itself is the data, so the attributes are its keys.

members.name: httpCallback
members.description:
Fetches the bytes of a file that the browser cannot load on its own, typically because the URL
needs an Authorization header. The thumbnail and the preview both go through it.

members.name: showOverlay
members.description:
Covers the thumbnail with `overlay` instead of the image. Use the function form to cover only
some of the files, for example the ones that are still being processed.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Allows more than one file. The control value is an array either way.

members.name: accept
members.description: The `accept` attribute of the file input, for example `'image/*'` or `'.pdf,.docx'`.

members.name: overlay
members.type: { backgroundColor: string; textColor: string; /** A translation key. */ text: string }
members.description: What `showOverlay` puts over the thumbnail.

FormFieldFilePreview.name: FormFieldFilePreview
FormFieldFilePreview.description:
A list of files with a thumbnail each, an upload button, and a preview or metadata dialog per file.
The control value is a `Lab900File[]`.

Use `EditType.DragNDrop` for files the user is about to upload, and this for files that already
exist and have to be shown.

It renders its own readonly state, so a readonly field still shows the thumbnails rather than text.

members.name: icon
members.description: The icon to show. Reactive, so it may follow the form value or a signal.

members.name: text
members.description: The text next to the icon. A translation key. Reactive, like `icon`.

FormFieldIcon.name: FormFieldIcon
FormFieldIcon.description:
An icon with a line of text. It reads the form and renders; it holds no value and takes no input,
so use it for a status or a hint inside the layout rather than for something to fill in.

An `attribute` is not needed. Give it one only when the icon depends on that control's own value.

FieldMask.name: FieldMask
FieldMask.description:
An `ngx-mask` configuration. Only `mask` is required; the rest of `NgxMaskConfig` overrides the
application defaults from `provideLab900Forms({ fieldMask })` for this one field.
FieldMask.example: fieldMask: { mask: '000/0000/0000' } // a Belgian company number

members.name: mask
members.description: The mask pattern, for example `'000.000-00'`. See the ngx-mask documentation for the tokens.

members.name: type
members.description: The `type` of the native input. `'number'` also makes the control validate as a number.

members.name: autofocus
members.description: Focuses the input once it renders. With more than one on a page the last one wins.

members.name: suffix
members.description: Text after the input, inside the form field. A translation key, or a function of the form value.

members.name: prefix
members.description: Text before the input, inside the form field. A translation key, or a function of the form value.

members.name: align
members.description: Which way the text in the input is aligned.

members.name: fieldMask
members.description: Formats what is typed through `ngx-mask`. Requires `provideNgxMask()` in the application.

members.name: showLengthIndicator
members.description:
Shows a character counter under the field. It needs a `maxLength` to count against. The
application-wide default is `provideLab900Forms({ formField: { showLengthIndicator } })`; this
option turns it on for one field.

members.name: style
members.description: Inline CSS on the input element itself.

FormFieldInput.name: FormFieldInput
FormFieldInput.description: A single line text input, the default field type.
FormFieldInput.example:
{
  attribute: 'email',
  title: 'label.email',
  editType: EditType.Input,
  validators: [Validators.email],
  errorMessages: { email: 'label.email-error' },
  options: { type: 'email', colspan: 6, required: true },
}

members.name: icon
members.description: An icon inside the form field, before or after the input.

FormFieldMultiLangOptions.name: FormFieldMultiLangOptions
FormFieldMultiLangOptions.description: Every option of {@link FormFieldInputOptions}, plus the ones for the language switch.

members.name: buttonColor
members.description: The Material palette of the translate button.

members.name: translateLabel
members.description: The label of the button that opens an input per language. A translation key.

members.name: stopTranslateLabel
members.description: The label of the button that closes them again. A translation key.

members.name: useTextAreaField
members.description: Renders a textarea per language instead of a single line input.

FormFieldMultiLang.name: FormFieldMultiLang
FormFieldMultiLang.description:
One value per language. The control value is an object keyed by language code:

```ts
{ title: { en: 'Welcome', nl: 'Welkom' } }
```

The field edits the language in the `language` input of `<lab900-form>` and offers the ones in
`availableLanguages`; the translate button opens an input for every language at once.

It renders its own readonly state, so a readonly field keeps showing one value per language
instead of collapsing an object into text.
FormFieldMultiLang.example:
<lab900-form [schema]="schema" [(data)]="page" language="en"
             [availableLanguages]="[{ value: 'en', label: 'English' }, { value: 'nl', label: 'Nederlands' }]" />

// and in the schema:
{ attribute: 'title', title: 'label.title', editType: EditType.MultiLangInput, options: { required: true } }

members.name: autofocus
members.description: Focuses the input once it renders.

members.name: align
members.description: Which way the text in the input is aligned.

members.name: style
members.description: Inline CSS on the input element itself.

members.name: togglePasswordVisibility
members.type: { /** Hides the toggle, so the value can never be read back. */ disabled: boolean; /** * The icon shown while the password is readable, which switches back to hidden. * @default { name: 'visibility_off' } */ passwordVisibleIcon?: Icon; /** * The icon shown while the password is masked, which reveals it. * @default { name: 'visibility' } */ passwordHiddenIcon?: Icon }
members.description: The eye icon that switches the input between `password` and `text`. Shown unless `disabled`.

FormFieldPassword.name: FormFieldPassword
FormFieldPassword.description:
A masked password input with a toggle that reveals the value.

Nothing here validates the strength of a password: add `validators` or `options.pattern` for that.

members.name: icon
members.description: An icon inside the form field, before or after the input.

members.name: radioOptions
members.description: The options to pick from. Required: without them the group renders empty.

members.name: color
members.description: The Material palette of the radio buttons.

FormFieldRadioButtons.name: FormFieldRadioButtons
FormFieldRadioButtons.description:
A radio group: every option is visible at once and exactly one can be picked. Use
`EditType.Select` when the list is long, and `EditType.ButtonToggle` for a compact row.

The options are a plain array, so they cannot be loaded from a server. Use a condition's
`conditionalOptions`, or an `EditType.Select`, when they depend on something else.

members.name: fromLabel
members.description: The label of the lower bound. A translation key.

members.name: toLabel
members.description: The label of the upper bound. A translation key.

members.name: enabledInputs
members.description: No effect: nothing reads this option. The number inputs next to the slider are always rendered.

members.name: steps
members.description: How far one step of the slider moves. Continuous when it is not set.

members.name: format
members.description:
How the bounds are printed. `'K-M'` shortens thousands to `k` and millions to `m`, and reads them
back, so `12 k` is 12000.

FormFieldRangeSlider.name: FormFieldRangeSlider
FormFieldRangeSlider.description:
A slider with a lower and an upper bound. The control value is a `[from, to]` tuple, and it starts
at `[min, max]` when the data holds nothing.

`options.min` and `options.max` are the ends of the slider here, not only validators, and they
default to 0 and 100.

members.name: fixedList
members.description:
Renders the rows without the add, remove and reorder buttons, so the number of rows is whatever
the data holds. The controls stay editable; use `readonly` to lock the values too.

members.name: removeAll
members.description:
Allows the last rows to be removed, down to an empty array. Without it the remove button stops at
`minRows`.

members.name: addLabel
members.description: The label of the add button. A translation key.

members.name: minRows
members.description:
The number of rows the array starts with and never drops below. `patchValues()` grows the array
back to it when the data holds fewer rows.

members.name: maxRows
members.description: Hides the add button once the array holds this many rows. Unlimited when it is not set.

members.name: buttonColor
members.description: The Material palette of the add, remove and reorder buttons.

members.name: enableReorder
members.description: Shows the move up and move down buttons on every row.

FormFieldRepeater.name: FormFieldRepeater
FormFieldRepeater.description:
A group of fields repeated over an `UntypedFormArray`. `nestedFields` is the schema of one row, and
the control value is an array of objects.

`patchValues()` on `<lab900-form>` grows and shrinks the array to match the data; `setValues()`
rebuilds it instead.

members.name: labelFormatter
members.description: Turns the found object into the text shown in the input. Required.

members.name: searchFn
members.description:
Looks the typed text up and returns the one match, or `null` when there is none. Required.
Emitting `null` clears the control and reveals the "add new" button.

members.name: debounceTime
members.description: How long typing pauses before the search runs.

members.name: notFoundLabel
members.description: The hint shown when the search came back empty. A translation key.

members.name: addNewLabel
members.description: The label of the button offered when nothing was found. A translation key.

members.name: addNewFn
members.description:
Function to handle the new item creation, can be anything.
The field will be updated with the observable response

members.name: disableSearchOnInput
members.description:
Stops the search from running while the user types, so only a paste or a blur triggers it. Use it
when the lookup is expensive and the input is a full code rather than a prefix.

members.name: addNewBtnColor
members.description: The Material palette of the "add new" button.

members.name: hideClearButton
members.description: Hides the clear button on the right of the field.

members.name: style
members.description: Inline CSS on the input element itself.

FormFieldSearch.name: FormFieldSearch
FormFieldSearch.typeParameters: T, R extends string | number = string
FormFieldSearch.description:
An input that looks its own value up: the user types, `searchFn` resolves one object, and the
control holds that object rather than the text.

It is a lookup for something identified exactly - an order number, a VAT number, a barcode - not a
list to browse. Use `EditType.Select` with `search.enabled` when the user should see the options.

FormFieldSelectOptionsFilter.name: FormFieldSelectOptionsFilter
FormFieldSelectOptionsFilter.description: What the select asks its `selectOptions` function for. Every field is filled in only when it applies.

members.name: page
members.description: The page to load, counted from 0. Only sent when `infiniteScroll.enabled` is set.

members.name: searchQuery
members.description: What the user typed in the search box. Only sent when `search.enabled` is set.

members.name: getAll
members.description: Set when "select all" needs the whole list, not only the page that is loaded.

FormFieldSelectOptionsFn.name: FormFieldSelectOptionsFn
FormFieldSelectOptionsFn.description:
Loads the options of a select. It may return an array or an `Observable`, and it is called again
whenever the filter changes, so the search and the paging can be answered by the server.
FormFieldSelectOptionsFn.type: ( filter?: FormFieldSelectOptionsFilter, fieldControl?: AbstractControl, schema?: FormFieldSelect<T> ) => ValueLabel<T>[] | Observable<ValueLabel<T>[]>

members.name: multiple
members.description: Lets more than one option be picked. The control value becomes an array.

members.name: showChipValue
members.description: Renders the picked options as removable chips instead of comma separated text. Needs `multiple`.

members.name: selectOptions
members.description:
The options to pick from: an array, an `Observable`, or a function of the current filter. Use the
function form when the server does the searching or the paging.

members.name: compareWith
members.description:
How a value is matched against an option. **Set this whenever the values are objects**: the
default comparison is `===`, so an object that came from the server never equals the one in the
options and the select renders empty although the control holds a value.

members.name: displayOptionFn
members.description: Renders the label of an option.
members.deprecated: Labels are set in the selectOptions ValueLabels

members.name: customTriggerFn
members.description: Renders the closed select yourself, instead of the label of the picked option.

members.name: autoselectOnlyOption
members.description: Picks the only option on its own when the list holds exactly one.

members.name: noOptionsIndicator
members.description: Will show an empty option displaying a message that no options could be found

members.name: noOptionsLabel
members.description:
Label to use to display when no options are available
noOptionsIndicator needs to be true for this to show

members.name: displaySelectedOptionFn
members.description: The function to display the current value of the select if this item is not present in the select options.

members.name: search
members.type: { enabled: boolean; /** A translation key. */ placeholder?: string; /** * Label to use to display a not found message based on given search message */ notFoundLabel?: string; /** The label of the "add new" button shown when the search finds nothing. A translation key. */ addNewLabel?: string; /** * Function to handle the new item creation, can be anything. * Use the select argument to update the select after creation */ addNewFn?: (searchQuery: string, select: SelectFieldComponent<T>) => void; addNewBtnColor?: ThemePalette; /** * Clear the search when the select closes * @default false */ clearOnClose?: boolean; /** * The threshold time before firing the search event */ debounceTime?: number }
members.description: A search box at the top of the option list.

members.name: infiniteScroll
members.type: { enabled: boolean; /** * The threshold distance from the bottom of the options list to call the infiniteScroll output event when scrolled. * The threshold value can be either in percent, or in pixels. * For example, use the value of 10% for the infiniteScroll output event to get called when the user has needs 10% to reach the bottom. */ threshold?: string; /** * The threshold time before firing the infiniteScroll event */ debounceTime?: number }
members.description: Loads the options page by page as the user scrolls. The pages come from `selectOptions` as a function.

members.name: clearFieldButton
members.type: { enabled: boolean | ((data?: T) => boolean); /** Runs instead of clearing the control, when clearing means more than emptying this one field. */ click?: (fieldControl: AbstractControl, clickEvent: Event) => void }
members.description: Shows a clear button on the right of the field

members.name: selectAll
members.type: { enabled: boolean; /** * A translation key. * @default 'forms.select-field.selectAllLabel' */ label?: string; disabled?: boolean }
members.description: A "select all" row above the options. Needs `multiple`.

members.name: panelWidth
members.description: The width of the option panel. Defaults to the width of the field.

members.name: panelClass
members.description: Extra classes on the option panel, for styling options from outside the field.

members.name: fetchOptionsOnFocus
members.description:
This will only request to select options once the select opens
The current value will be the only option until the select is opened

FormFieldSelect.name: FormFieldSelect
FormFieldSelect.typeParameters: T, R extends string | number = string
FormFieldSelect.description:
A dropdown, optionally searchable, multi-select and paged. It replaces the deprecated
`EditType.Autocomplete`: set `search.enabled` for the same behaviour.

With object values always set `compareWith`, or the picked value matches no option and the field
looks empty.

members.name: label
members.description: The text next to the toggle. A translation key. Falls back to the `title` of the field.

members.name: labelPosition
members.description: Which side of the toggle the label sits on.

members.name: color
members.description: The Material palette of the toggle.

FormFieldSlideToggle.name: FormFieldSlideToggle
FormFieldSlideToggle.description:
An on/off switch. Use it for a setting that takes effect immediately in the reader's mind; a
checkbox reads better for something that is confirmed when the form is submitted.

It keeps rendering the toggle when the field is readonly instead of collapsing into text, so the
state stays recognisable.

members.name: showLengthIndicator
members.description:
Shows a character counter under the field. It needs a `maxLength` to count against. The
application-wide default is `provideLab900Forms({ formField: { showLengthIndicator } })`; this
option turns it on for one field.

FormFieldTextarea.name: FormFieldTextarea
FormFieldTextarea.description: A multi line text input. The textarea grows with its content.

members.name: editorConfig
members.description:
The `@kolkov/angular-editor` configuration: toolbar buttons, height, fonts, upload handler. The
field fills in `editable` and `placeholder` from the schema; everything else is passed through.

WysiwgFieldModel.name: WysiwgFieldModel
WysiwgFieldModel.description:
A rich text editor from `@kolkov/angular-editor`. The control value is an HTML string, so treat it
as untrusted on the way back in and sanitize before rendering it anywhere else.

The editor's icons are served from the application, not from the library: add the
`@kolkov/angular-editor` icon glob to the `assets` of `angular.json` or the toolbar renders blank.

members.name: fieldAttribute
members.description:
The name of this field's control inside {@link _group}. `FormFieldDirective` sets it from
`schema.attribute`, with the path of a dotted attribute already stripped off, so it is the last
segment: the `street` of `address.street`.

members.name: group
members.description:
The group this field's control lives in. For a dotted attribute that is the nested group, not the
group of the whole form.

members.name: schema
members.description: The field's own entry from `Lab900FormConfig.fields`, narrowed to this component's edit type.

members.name: externalForms
members.description:
The other forms this field's conditions may reach, keyed by their `formId`. Passed down from the
`externalForms` input of `<lab900-form>` and resolved by `IFieldConditions.externalFormId`.

members.name: language
members.description: The language an `EditType.MultiLangInput` currently edits. Ignored by every other edit type.

members.name: availableLanguages
members.description: The languages an `EditType.MultiLangInput` offers. Ignored by every other edit type.

members.name: readonly
members.description:
Field state.

These are the way a field changes its own state: an effect writes each one through to the
`AbstractControl`, so setting the model disables the control or adds `Validators.required`. Never
call `disable()` or `setValidators()` on the control from a field component; set the model and
let the base class do it, or the next recalculation undoes the change.

members.name: fieldIsHidden
members.description: Hides the field and disables its control, so it stops validating.

members.name: fieldIsRequired
members.description: Adds or removes `Validators.required` on the control.

Lab900Form.name: Lab900Form
Lab900Form.description:
Renders a reactive form from a schema. It builds the `UntypedFormGroup` from
`Lab900FormConfig.fields` and renders every field, so there is no per-field template.

Read the state through a `viewChild`: `form` is the group, `value` is `getRawValue()` (so
readonly and disabled fields are included) and `valid` is true when the group is valid or
entirely disabled.

members.name: data
members.description:
The value of the form. Two-way: setting it patches the controls, and the form writes the
current value back.

members.name: schema
members.description:
The schema to render. The form builds its `UntypedFormGroup` from `schema.fields`.

Keep it in a class field: a new object on every change detection rebuilds the form and loses
the values the user has typed.

members.name: externalForms
members.description:
Other form groups that the conditions of this form may depend on, keyed by the `formId` of
those forms. A condition reaches them through `IFieldConditions.externalFormId`.

members.name: emitEventOnDataChange
members.description:
Whether patching the `data` input fires `valueChanges` on the controls. Set it to `false` to
load a record without triggering the listeners of your own form.

members.name: language
members.description: The language that an `EditType.MultiLangInput` field currently edits.

members.name: availableLanguages
members.description: The languages an `EditType.MultiLangInput` field offers.

`schema.attribute`, with the path of a dotted attribute already stripped off, so it is the last
segment: the `street` of `address.street`.

group of the whole form.

FormDialogDirective.name: FormDialogDirective
FormDialogDirective.description:
Opens a schema in a `MatDialog` when the host element is clicked, so a form can hang off a button
or a table row without a dialog component of its own.

Every input except `disabled` is required, `dialogOptions` included: pass `{}` when the Material
defaults will do.

members.name: schema
members.description: The schema the dialog renders.

members.name: data
members.description: The record the form starts from. It is not mutated; the edited copy reaches `submitFormHandler`.

members.name: submitFormHandler
members.description:
Saves the edited record. The dialog closes when the promise resolves `true` and stays open on
`false`, so a failed save keeps what the user typed.

members.name: dialogOptions
members.description: `MatDialogConfig` for the dialog: width, panel class, and the rest. Pass `{}` for the defaults.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Stops the click from opening anything.

members.name: image
members.description:
The file to render. Two-way: the directive writes the bytes it fetched back into `imageBase64`,
so the preview dialog does not download the same image again.

members.name: httpCallback
members.description:
Fetches the bytes, for an image the browser cannot load on its own - typically because the URL
needs an Authorization header. Without it the element just points at `image.imageSrc`.

`fetchImageBase64` accepts and converts an `ArrayBuffer`, so the callback may return either. The
showcase passes a request with `responseType: 'arraybuffer'`, which the old `Observable<Blob>` type
excluded.

members.name: defaultImage
members.description: Shown when the image has no source or the fetch fails.

members.name: autofocus
members.description:
Focuses the `matInput` when it turns true, including later on, so a field revealed by a condition
still takes the caret. With more than one on a page the last one to turn true wins.
